## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `df862934541eca57449da99ad633e7a6fa746f83`
Local-runs: probe — one `node` run of a scratch script holding the three regexes copied verbatim from the head (`DEFAULT_BINDING_IMPORT_RE`, `BRACED_IMPORT_RE` at L3217-3219; `packageReference`'s `mention` at L4867, beside main's) against 27 crafted import shapes and 27 crafted string values; nothing built, no gate or self-test re-run, no worktree, no ablation
Scope: scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs (the one changed path; `reviewFace` returns no `hits` for `scripts/**`, so the schema-face floor is the diff itself) + the cited code read unchanged at the head: `metadataSurfaceReference` (L3170-3205), `importSpecifiersFor` (L2973), `specifierNamesModule` / `owningPackageName` (L2982-3009), `metadataSurfaceKind` / `metadataSurfaceFilesAt` (L2783-2797), the `runtime-export-retired` predicate-2 caller (L5176-5262), `parseExportOperand` / `PACKAGE_NAME_RE` (L4501-4540), the self-test ledger (`SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`, `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` L500, the floor check L9735-9775, `red`/`green`/`assert` L5960-6085, the REX and WP fixtures L7653-7760, 8216-8235); scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs (`maskComments` → `blank`, spaces for comment bytes, newlines kept, strings left standing); docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md on main `4265176c` (D7 step 4, D9 predicate 2, the second 2026-10-27 note L1146-1183); packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts and examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts on main, and the 418 metadata-surface paths main's classifier selects, grepped read-only for the shapes judged below. No remainder: the diff is one file and it is in scope.

Inputs read (GET only): card #26324 body and all 4 comments (triage 6428250876, serial-wait 6430725274, claim 6465577081, os-dev-report 6466700067); card #27022 body and both comments (triage 6459401704, claim 6465589776); the director's contract review 6458009682 on PR #26766; PR #27207 body, file list (1 file, +126/−4), commits (`2e1e09d5` fix, `df862934` merge of main), zero issue comments, zero review comments, zero reviews; the net diff against main; check-runs on `df862934` read at 10:35:02Z (12 in_progress), 10:40:57Z (1 in_progress), 10:42:31Z (1 in_progress, `Test Core` aggregator) and **10:43:10Z: 45 check-runs, 26 `success`, 19 `skipped`, 0 failure, 0 in_progress**. The head had not moved at 10:43Z (`draft: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`).

Gate verdicts on the head: `Lint · docs & code guards` (where `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests` runs this gate's `--self-test`), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, every Type Check lane, `Test Core` and its two shards, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`: all `success`. `Check Changeset` `success` (the `skip-changeset` label is on). The gate's `--base` scan judged nothing on this head (no changeset in the diff), as expected. The dev's 33 derived families at exit 0 and `--ran: 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED` are the dev's report; the CI lanes above are what this record measured.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. #26324, the `default` operand — the three ordinary shapes are read, right, and other names are untouched.** `metadataSurfaceReference` (L3171) routes `symbol === 'default'` to `defaultImportReference` (L3236-3247) before the bare-word arm; every other name falls through to the unchanged word scan, `declaresLocally`, member-offset clearing and `importSpecifiersFor` (L3172-3204 are byte-identical to main). The new reader masks comments with the shared `maskComments` (spaces, newlines kept, so the `m`-flag `^` anchor and `[ \t]*` land where a docblock stood), collects every specifier of a default-binding import (`DEFAULT_BINDING_IMPORT_RE`) and of a braced `import`/`export … from` whose brace content holds the word `default` (`BRACED_IMPORT_RE`), and attributes each through the existing `specifierNamesModule` (relative resolution; bare name equal to the declaring package or a subpath of it, the coarse refuse-direction match). Probe, head regexes, specifier `@objectstack/driver-memory`: `import x from`, `import x, { y } from`, `import x, * as ns from`, `import type x from 'pkg/sub'`, a multi-line `import x, {\n y,\n} from`, comment spans blanked inside the statement, `import { default as x } from`, `import {\n type default as X,\n} from`, `export { default } from`, `export { default as x } from`, indented and double-quoted, after `;` on the same line, after CRLF, with `with { type: 'json' }`: all read as `import`. A named-bindings-only import, a `default:` key and a `.default('')` call: none read (DX-U2 pins this). `import type from 'pkg'` (a default binding named `type`) is read.

**2. #26324 — the shapes the reader does NOT see, graded.** The brief asked for one case per shape where the gate now passes while a metadata surface really reaches the default export. Found, by probe:
   - (a) `import * as ns from '@objectstack/driver-memory'` then `ns.default` — **not read, admitted** (the dev declares it, PR body "Not read for `default`, by design").
   - (b) `const m = await import('@objectstack/driver-memory')` / `require(…)` then `m.default` — **not read, admitted** (declared likewise).
   - (c) `export * as ns from '@objectstack/driver-memory'` (re-exports the namespace, `default` included) — not read, admitted, not declared.
   - (d) `import{default as x}from'pkg'` with no whitespace after `import`/`export` — not read (`\s+` is required); `importSpecifiersFor` has the same limit, so other names fall to the bare-word arm here while `default` has no fallback.
   - (e) A BOM before a first-line `import x from` — `[ \t]*` does not cross U+FEFF (the old arm's `\s*` does). No metadata surface on main carries a BOM (grepped, 0 files).
   For every other export name, shape (a) is REFUSED today as a `mention` (the word scan hits `ns.Foo`, no specifier names `Foo`, so the branch returns `mention`), and so is (b): the `default` reading is laxer than every other name's on exactly these two shapes, and D9 predicate 2 → D7 step 4 ("no metadata surface references it in code") refuses them by text. ⚠️ The dev's reason for leaving (a) and (b) unread — "both reach the export through a member named `default`, the very spelling that cannot be told from the object keys" — does not hold for (a): the namespace binding is what tells it (`import * as NS from 'DECLARING-MODULE'` followed by `\bNS\s*\.\s*default\b` is linear and unambiguous), and for (b) the conservative D7 reading is a dynamic `import('DECLARING-MODULE')` in a metadata surface at all, exactly as `packageReference`'s `spec` already treats `import('…')` as an import for `PACKAGE#*`. **Graded should-fix, not blocking**, on the same calibration the director applied to the path/URL residual on PR #26766 (6458009682 ①-1): on main's 418 metadata surfaces there are 0 namespace imports, 0 default imports, 0 `import{` spellings, and every `import(` / `require(` hit is inside a comment or a `.describe()` string; the shapes the card measured and triage bound ("read the import arm only … `import x from 'PKG'`") are all refused and pinned (DX-R1, DX-R2, DX-U1). A card should carry (a), (b) and (c): one `ns.default` red, one dynamic-import red, both read through the declaring specifier.
   - False-refuse side (the second-worst direction): `export { x as default } from 'DECLARING-MODULE'` is read as reaching `default` (the brace content holds the word) and a default import written on its own line inside a template literal is read as a statement (strings are left standing, the same posture as the old arm). Both unrealistic in a metadata surface; noted.

**3. The performance claim.** `importSpecifiersFor`'s pattern `(?:^|\n)\s*(?:import|export)\s+([\s\S]*?)\s*from\s*['"]…` carries a lazy `[\s\S]*?` behind a `\s*` that can start at every newline of a masked file, so the super-linear behaviour the dev measured on `discovery.zod.ts` is the shape the code predicts; the two new regexes are anchored at `^`/`;` and have no lazy any-char scan (`[^}]*` and `[^'"\n]+` are bounded). The dev's "left as it is: its callers gate it on the word being present" is accurate (L3198 runs it only after three word tests pass). Not re-measured here.

**4. #27022, the mention regex — right, and the brief's checks all hold.** Head: `(?<![\w@.-])(?<!@[\w.~-]+/)NAME(?![\w.-])`; main: `(?<![\w@./-])NAME(?![\w.-])`. Probe on the two regexes side by side, unscoped operand `plugin-x`: `'@scope/plugin-x'`, `'/repo/node_modules/@other/plugin-x/dist/index.js'`, `'https://npm.im/@other/plugin-x'` → null on both (the second lookbehind refuses a `/` that closes an `@scope` segment, scope characters `[\w.~-]`); `'plugin-xy'`, `'my-plugin-x'` → null (boundaries unchanged); `'plugin-x@1.0.0'` → mention on both (the version spec stays refused, `@` is not in the lookahead set); `'/repo/node_modules/plugin-x/dist/index.js'`, `'https://npm.im/plugin-x'`, `'https://x.dev/plugin-x?v=1&q=2'`, `'node_modules/.pnpm/plugin-x@1.0.0/node_modules/plugin-x/index.js'` → mention on head, null on main (the #27022 gap, closed); Windows `'C:\\…\\node_modules\\plugin-x\\dist'` → mention on both. Scoped operand `@object-ui/plugin-x`: `'/repo/node_modules/@object-ui/plugin-x/dist/index.js'`, `'https://npm.im/@object-ui/plugin-x'`, the pnpm store path `node_modules/.pnpm/@object-ui+plugin-x@1.0.0/node_modules/@object-ui/plugin-x/dist` → mention on head, null on main; `'@object-ui/plugin-xy'`, `'x@object-ui/plugin-x'` → null. The comment-only case stays green by construction: `mention` runs on `maskComments(rawText)` and WP-G3 is unchanged in the diff. Imports are still reported as `import` because `spec` is tried first (unchanged). The widening is refuse-direction only, as the body says.
   - Refuse-direction residuals, all for an UNSCOPED operand only: a relative specifier or path to a local file of the same name (`'./plugin-x'`, now a mention; was null on main), a bare `@/` alias segment (`'@/plugin-x'`, the scope lookbehind needs one character after `@`), Windows `'@scope\\plugin-x'` and the pnpm store spelling `@scope+plugin-x` (both already mentions on main). The workspace's only unscoped published package is `create-objectstack` (every other published name is `@objectstack/*` or `@object-ui/*`), and a metadata surface naming a local file `./create-objectstack` is not a realistic shape. Noted, not blocking.

**5. Battery — the new cases pin what they claim; nothing existing was edited or removed.** The diff has no `−` line inside `selfTest()` other than the WP floor `55 → 59`; every other hunk in the self-test is an addition. Counted from the diff text (one per `green`, one plus the regex count per `red`, one per `assert`): DX = 3 greens + 2 reds × (1 + 1) + 4 asserts = **11**, equal to the pinned floor; WP adds 4 asserts, 55 → **59**; 682 + 15 = **697**, the figure the body and the dev report print and the Lint lane measured `success`. DX-G1's fixture retires `default` for real: base `REX_INDEX_BASE + export default {…}`, head `REX_INDEX_HEAD` (no default), beside a metadata surface carrying `default: true` and one carrying `.default('')` — the #26206 shape; DX-G1b asserts the verdict names `default (export, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/index.ts)`. DX-R1/R2's regex matches the caller's refusal text at L5244-5247 exactly (`… (an object definition) IMPORTS \`default\``). DX-G2 (comment-quoted import), DX-G3 (another module's default via `@objectstack/spec`, refused by `specifierNamesModule`), DX-U1 (the `;`-anchored multi-line `export {\n default,\n} from`), DX-U2, DX-U3 (another name keeps the bare-word arm) each pin the branch they name. WP-U6/U7 assert `kind === 'mention'` AND the reported line; WP-U8 covers bare, path and URL; WP-U9 pins that the refused `/` is only a scope's.
   - ⚠️ **Should-fix: `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` stays 58 while the roster grows to 59.** Every prior battery addition on main bumped it (55→56 `46255b19`, 56→57 `e890bedc`, 57→58 `4bce21da`); the floor's own comment says a battery deleted from the roster "takes its own floor with it", and at 58 the DX entry is the one battery whose deletion, block and roster line together, would trip nothing. One line: `const SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR = 59;`. Not blocking: the per-battery floor `DX: 11` is live and is what catches cases that stop running.

**6. The driver-memory probe — the code supports the dev's three readings.** On main `72629f38`'s gate, `metadataSurfaceReference('default', 'packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts', …)` word-scans `\bdefault\b`; `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts:27` carries `{ label: 'Technology', value: 'technology', default: true }` (an object definition under main's classifier), is not `declaresLocally`, has no import → `mention` → exit 1, the card's reading. With this PR's gate: `defaultImportReference` reads the 418 surfaces; none on main imports `@objectstack/driver-memory` at all (grep: the name occurs only in comments and as a string key in `error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1406`, which this operand's reader does not read) → null; predicate 1 holds (`export default {` at `index.ts:64` on main, deleted in the probe head; the symbol's declaration file is `index.ts`, the `verified:` line's path) → exit 0. With a base-side `.object.ts` carrying `import memoryPlugin from '@objectstack/driver-memory'`: `DEFAULT_BINDING_IMPORT_RE` yields the specifier, `owningPackageName(declPath)` is `@objectstack/driver-memory`, equal → `{ kind: 'import' }` → exit 1 with "IMPORTS `default` from the module that declares it". Not re-run (read-only).

**7. Declarations.** `Clause-②: no` — right: `scripts/**` is unpublished, the root is private, no published accept set moves; the claim carried `no` and the body copies it, so the order's expected `n/a` is a spelling difference the dev surfaced, not a deviation. `Metadata-protocol: none` — right, no metadata shape moves. `Skills-docs: none` — confirmed: `git grep` over `skills/` on main for `runtime-export-retired`, `no-metadata-surface`, `check-adr-0087`, `adr-0087`: 0 hits; neither predicate is taught there. `skip-changeset` — right. ADR text: D9's second 2026-10-27 note already reads "any other occurrence of the package name, a string value included" (L1174-1175), which the path/URL mention now satisfies, and the `default` reading is D7's import primitive the note points to; no ADR line needs to move. `Fixes #26324`: the card's Expected (import arm only; a green with an unrelated `default:` key, a red with the import) is met by DX-G1/DX-R1; its "Also seen (not filed)" item (predicate 3's FROM reader on a two-span line) is noted-only and outside the card. `Fixes #27022`: the card's Expected (path/URL mention with a U-case, WP-G3 and WP-U4 still green) and triage's two asks (a path U-case and an `@scope/` non-match U-case) are met by WP-U6/U8. Nothing on either card is left undone.

### ② Semver level

No release: `skip-changeset` is correct (root `private`, `scripts/**` unshipped, no package version moves). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Accept set of the gate: narrowed for `PACKAGE#*` (more refused), widened for an export operand named `default` only (the bare-word arm no longer refuses it); every other export name's reading is unchanged, read off L3172-3204.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **(a) `ns.default` and dynamic `import()` / `require()` not read for `default` (dev flag, PR body "Not read for `default`, by design").** Accepted as declared, **should-fix, not blocking** — see ①-2: the namespace shape IS tellable by its binding name and the dynamic shape by its specifier, both shapes are refused today for every other export name, and the ADR text refuses them; 0 occurrences on main's metadata surfaces. Escalated to the seat as a card to file against this gate (three reds: namespace, dynamic import, `export * as ns from`).
- **(b) `importSpecifiersFor` left super-linear, "noted, not filed".** Accepted: its callers gate it on three word tests (L3173, 3184, 3197), so no current run is slow; the dev's out_of_scope_findings line carries it.
- **(c) `Clause-②: no` where the order expected `n/a`.** Accepted: both claims carry `no`, the body copies the claim, and `no` is accurate (no published accept set moves).
- **(d) Roster floor not bumped (not a dev flag; found here).** Should-fix, one line, ①-5. Not blocking.
- **(e) Refuse-direction residuals for an unscoped operand (`./plugin-x`, `@/plugin-x`).** Noted in ①-4; no unscoped published package but `create-objectstack`, and no realistic metadata surface writes the shape. Not blocking, no card asked.
- **(f) The branch name.** `claude/project-thread-mvhzud` is the platform-assigned thread branch, written as measured in both claims; it is the PR's head ref. Accepted.
- **(g) Gates.** All 45 check-runs completed `success` or `skipped` at 10:43:10Z, none failed; the gate's own `--self-test` ran `success` in `Lint · docs & code guards`. The 33 derived families at exit 0 are the dev's report, consistent with the CI lanes, not re-run here.
- **(h) Approval state.** `draft: true`, zero reviews on the PR; Tier H approval is not this record's to give. The seat's ACCEPT may proceed on this head.
- **(i) Probe disclosure.** One local run, declared on the `Local-runs:` line: a scratch script with the three regexes copied from L3217-3219 and L4867, run once against crafted strings. No build, no gate run, no self-test run, no worktree.

Should-fix, none blocking: a card for ③-(a); `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR = 59` (①-5), which the dev may land on this PR or the next touch of the file.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-mvhzud`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f402e245ca3693c32d0ec7059a075d2d0d40c0e1`
Local-runs: probe — one `node` run of a scratch script holding the two new readers copied verbatim from the head (`NAMESPACE_IMPORT_RE`, `DYNAMIC_IMPORT_RE`, L3222-3223) against 18 crafted strings and four 1-2 MB pathological inputs timed; nothing built, no gate or self-test re-run, no worktree, no ablation
Scope: scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs (the one changed path, read as the delta `df862934...f402e245`, +34/−9, one commit) + the cited code read unchanged at the new head: `defaultImportReference` whole (L3240-3253), `DEFAULT_BINDING_IMPORT_RE` / `BRACED_IMPORT_RE` (L3219-3221), `specifierNamesModule` / `owningPackageName` (L2982-3009), the `runtime-export-retired` predicate-2 caller, `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` and `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` (L423-500) at main `4265176c`, `df862934` and `f402e245`, the floor check (L9760-9800); scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs (`maskComments`); the 418 metadata-surface paths main's classifier selects, grepped read-only for namespace imports, namespace re-exports and quoted dynamic `import(` / `require(` calls. No remainder.

Round 2 on the head that answers the PASS record on `df862934` (comment 6466959531, its two should-fixes ③-(a) and ①-5). Inputs read: the compare diff `df862934...f402e245` and the commit message of `f402e245` ("fix(adr-0087): a `default` operand is reached by a namespace or dynamic load of its module"); the PR body as the seat applied it (diffed line by line against the round-1 body: the 「维护者速读」 bullets, the "Round 2" bullet, the DX roster line, `697 → 705`, the `9dacccf9` probe row, the rewritten acceptance note, the derived-gates block at `f402e245`); zero new PR comments or reviews; check-runs on `f402e245` read at 11:13:17Z (1 in_progress, `PR-body guards`) and **11:14:47Z: 44 check-runs, 26 `success`, 18 `skipped`, 0 failure, 0 in_progress**; the head had not moved at 11:14Z (`draft: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`). Everything round 1 read stands and is not re-read.

Gate verdicts on the head: `Lint · docs & code guards` (where `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests` runs this gate's `--self-test`) and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` `success`; every other Lint lane, every Type Check lane, `Test Core` and its shards, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`: `success`. The dev's 33 derived families at exit 0 at `f402e245` are the dev's report, consistent with the lanes.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. Should-fix ③-(a) — fixed, and it closes the admit gap round 1 named.** Two readers are added beside the two of round 1 and feed the same `specifiers` list, attributed through the same `specifierNamesModule` (L3251): `NAMESPACE_IMPORT_RE` — statement-anchored (`(?:^|;)[ \t]*`), `import` or `export`, optional `type`, `* as IDENT from 'spec'`; `DYNAMIC_IMPORT_RE` — `\b(?:import|require)\s*\(\s*'spec'\s*\)`. The prefilter admits a file holding `require` as well (L3242). Probe, head regexes: `import * as ns from 'M'`, `import type * as ns from 'M'`, `export * as ns from 'M'`, `import('M')`, `import("M/sub")`, `require('M')` → each yields the declaring specifier; `export * from 'M'` (which does not re-export `default`) yields nothing, right. The refusal rests on the binding of the module, never on a `.default` read, exactly as the body says, and that is the posture every other export name already has on these shapes (round 1 ①-2). The three shapes round 1 listed — (a) namespace import, (b) dynamic `import()`/`require()`, (c) `export * as ns from` — are all read; DX-R3 to DX-R6 pin each with the predicate-2 refusal regex `DX_P2`, in the full `run()` path.

**2. Over-refusal — the questions asked, answered.**
   - *A comment*: both readers run on `maskComments(rawText)` (L3243), so a comment-quoted `import * as ns from 'M'` or `import('M')` is spaces; probe on a blanked line yields nothing. DX-G2 keeps pinning the comment case for the import arm.
   - *A different package sharing the prefix*: `import * as ns from '@objectstack/driver-memory-foo'` and `import('@objectstack/driver-memory-foo')` are collected as specifiers but refused by `specifierNamesModule` (`specifier === owner || specifier.startsWith(owner + '/')`), so `pkg-foo` never names `pkg`. Right.
   - *A string literal*: `NAMESPACE_IMPORT_RE` is statement-anchored, so `'import * as ns from "M"'` inside a string on a code line yields nothing; `DYNAMIC_IMPORT_RE` is NOT anchored, so a string literal quoting `import("M")` — a `.describe('… import("@objectstack/driver-memory") …')`, say — would refuse, and so would a method call named `import` (`registry.import('M')`), which `\b` does not keep out. Refuse-direction residuals, graded noted: main's 418 metadata surfaces carry 0 quoted-specifier `import(` or `require(` calls of any kind (grep `\b(import|require)\s*\(\s*['"]`: 0 lines; the five `import(` hits of round 1 are prose in comments and one `.describe()` string that names `@libsql/client`, not a workspace package), 0 namespace imports and 0 namespace re-exports. A `(?<![.\w$])` lookbehind on the dynamic reader would close the method-call shape; a card is not owed for it.
   - *Admit-direction residual, noted*: a dynamic `import(` with a template-literal specifier (`` import(`M`) ``) is not read (the quote set is `'"`), the same set `packageReference`'s `spec` uses. Not a realistic metadata-surface shape.

**3. The readers are linear.** Neither carries a lazy `[\s\S]*?`; the only unbounded classes are `\s+`/`\s*` runs between fixed tokens and `[^'"\n]+` inside a quote pair, and each alternation is anchored by a literal keyword, so a failed match retreats by at most one token run. Probe timings on the head regexes over pathological inputs: 400 lines of `import` followed by 5000 spaces (2.0 MB) 24 ms; 400 unclosed `import( … 'x` lines (1.6 MB) 15 ms; 400 unterminated `import * as x from` + 5000 spaces lines (2.0 MB) 18 ms; 50 runs of 20000 `;` before `import * as x` (1.0 MB) 4 ms. No catastrophic shape found.

**4. The driver-memory probe stays green — the code supports it.** On main, no metadata surface imports `@objectstack/driver-memory` by any of the four shapes: the name occurs only in comments, in `.describe()` / message strings (`discovery.zod.ts:72`, `filter.zod.ts`, `query.zod.ts`, `error-code-ledger.zod.ts:2057`) and as a string key (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1406`), none of which is a statement-anchored import or a quoted `import(`/`require(` call; so `defaultImportReference` returns null and the dev's `exit 0` with `verified: @objectstack/driver-memory#default (export, …/src/index.ts)` on `9dacccf9` is what the code predicts. Not re-run (read-only).

**5. Should-fix ①-5 — fixed, and the bump matches the roster.** `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 58 → 59 (L500). Counted from the file text: `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` holds 71 entries on main `4265176c` and 72 at both `df862934` and `f402e245` — one battery added (DX), one floor step, the convention every prior addition followed (55→56→57→58). The DX entry's own floor moves 11 → 19: 4 new `red` × (1 + 1 regex) = 8, 11 + 8 = **19**, equal to the pin; the self-test total 697 + 8 = **705**, the figure the body prints and the Lint lane measured `success`. The delta removes no existing assertion (the diff's only `−` lines are the two pins, the prefilter line and the docblock paragraph it rewrites).

**6. Declarations and body.** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs: none`, `skip-changeset`, `Fixes #26324` / `Fixes #27022`: unchanged and still right (the delta is the same unpublished script). The body now says four linear regexes, names DX-R3 to R6, prints `705`, carries the round-2 probe row and replaces the "Not read for `default`, by design" note with the binding-not-member note; the 「两分钟验证」 promise is `705 assertions`, matching the pin. The ADR needs no line: D7 step 4's "no metadata surface references it" is what the readers now enforce for `default`.

### ② Semver level
